description: This file defines the Subordinate class, which extends ListableDisplayField, and represents a display field component related to subordinate employees in the HRM report system of OrangeHRM. It specifies the DTO class used, the fields to be retrieved, and entity aliases for reporting features.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: A display field class for subordinate employees in HR reports, providing methods to get associated DTO class, report fields, and entity aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field, specifically 'Dto\Subordinate'.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of report fields, here specifying 'employee.empNumber' as the relevant employee number field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in report query, here 'subordinate'.
